steps.text: Mama? Mama, where are you going?
To the highlands? The flowery highlands?
But that's where the bad man who hurt Papa is? Are you going to punish him?
Will that bring Papa back?
No?
Then... I don't want you to go.
You have to go? But I don't want you to go back to Ursus... The bread there is so hard. And winter is so cold.
Mama?
Mama...
Mama never came back either.
I used the money she left me to continue my studies in Ursus, and to live.
Alone.
I waited alone for years. I lived alone for years.
Until Dr. Kal'tsit appeared before me. She said she was the head of a research institute, and she came to get me.
Dr. Kal'tsit was tired then. Even more tired than she is now. I later learned she had just returned from some faraway place when she found me.
After that, I joined Rhodes Island.
I asked Dr. Kal'tsit where Mama went. She didn't say much, just that Mama and Papa were together, buried deep inside Ursus.
She is my most respected teacher, my most honored leader. She guided me, educated me, not only with her words, but also through what she and her countless operators did for the Infected.
But the one thing Dr. Kal'tsit never did... was answer my simplest question...
On whom, or what, do I take my revenge?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Lisa, you don't have to come with me.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I'm worried.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You shouldn't be. I'm just going to look around and see if maybe there are some clues about that armed Infected group.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Do you think they're behind it?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm not sure. That's the obvious answer, since we have no evidence.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But with the town as it is, they're the most likely suspects, aren't they?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And 'Winterwisp.' Severin wouldn't say much about it, so I can't be sure exactly what it means. But since they're in cahoots with the militia group, they're at the top of the list too.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: The mountain range near here is called the Winterwisp Mountains. It's a barren place, covered with ice and snow year round... could that have to do with anything?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I really don't know. All I can say for sure is I have to find our murderer, and then pull my answers out of them.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic, you've been really... scary. Since yesterday.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm sorry, Lisa.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Not everyone is so easily calmed.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This is the second time I've had to say goodbye to someone like that. And this time, I'm not leaving with regrets.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Come out. I won't hurt you.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Aww. I like to think I'm pretty good at hiding. How did you see me?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hmm... Intuition? Let's call it that...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Oof. This guy seems like a pain in the ass.)

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (Then stop talking to him.)

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I've gone through some of Rhodes Island's battle records. You're no ordinary Infected.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Rhodes Island? So you are Rhodes Island Operators...?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: What do we do? Fight?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: GreyThroat isn't back yet... We have to stall him, at least.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Calm down. Don't attack him. Click!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Gah! I- I'm sorry!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm...? Did I see your pupils flash red for a moment? Is that some kind of stress reaction?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Did I scare you? Sorry. I just wanted you two to know, you can't fight me.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If you are from Wolumonde, you'd better leave. It's dangerous. If angry Winterwisps or Infected found you... You'd be in mortal danger.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Thanks for the warning.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: But why are you here?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I just came to lay some flowers. And then I'll leave.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Is that an ordinary wildflower you're holding there?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's cold here in the fall. I dream a lot... I dream of these flowers. They're like the children of that snowy mountain... icy cold.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Rest in peace.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Did he really just come to pray? He wouldn't just be using this as a cover for some kind of Originium Arts, would he?)

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (With his face hidden, I can't tell whether he's lying or not. But...)

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (He does seem genuinely sad.)

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Don't move. Don't turn around. Put your hands up.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: GreyThroat!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: When did you get here? You're pretty smooth...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Whatever. Your bolts can't hurt me, Rhodes Island crossbowman.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I said don't move. I just want to ask you something.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A conversation doesn't reveal your strength... what's the point?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Don't say I didn't warn you!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Look. I've caught your bolt. You can't put a scratch on me.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: He blocked her shot with a rock?!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: N- no! It's Arts! He actually 'caught' the bolt! With mud!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: At least you didn't shoot without warning. I hate sneak attacks. You're not so bad.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: And... Hm, if you wound up that second bolt... what would've happened?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That depends on whether or not you have time to protect your neck with your Arts.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm... Even if I don't, I do have a very thick suit of armor...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Doesn't matter. Since you have no intention of fighting to the death, I've had enough.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Can I go?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Sorry, but no.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...As expected. *Sigh*.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So many Leithanians have joined us, and our ranks have grown bountiful and diverse...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But... You, a crossbowman, you would not have missed this symbol. This is a symbol that once belonged to the Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Reunion lit the fire that was, is, and will always be burning across all corners of Terra.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But, Reunion does not represent all Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: So, what about you? Are you from Leithanien yourself? Or are you an exile who wandered here, weighed down by sin and intrigue?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Me...? Hm... I guess so. Our aimless journey began in Kazdel. And we've been on the run ever since.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Wolumonde is a mess. And I'm sure you had something to do with it.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Right. There's no way we wouldn't.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But I... am not Reunion either. Not anymore. I'm just the captain of Mudrock Squad. A... mercenary? No, let's say I'm just an Infected.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Why does it seems like he's always talking to himself? What kind of Reunion guy thinks like that?)

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: (Please be quiet while the team leader negotiates. If you really have nothing better to do, you can record it.)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Oh yeah! Fire up the camera...)

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But, really... What am I? I'm not a mercenary. I'm not Reunion. As things are now, I'm...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: My Arts dirtied the flowers... They're so hard to find, this time of year.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If you want to fight, can we do it somewhere else?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You have a way with words... But no.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Click, Ayerscarpe, keep your guard up. But don't attack him. Stay clear.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: One of our operators seems to have gotten caught up in this fire. I need answers.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: My condolences, but... We also lost four of ours to the fire.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We're not so good with crime scene investigation or anything like that... But there are a lot of Leithanians with us.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: They've all been educated, and they have a natural talent for Arts unlike people from other countries.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: At least... I am sure someone did this. And it was no accident.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If we knew, he'd already be dead and the town would be at peace.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Then tell me what you do know. Like, what was that Winterwisp you just mentioned?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I think you misunderstood. I am not your enemy. I'm only here to pay respects to my people.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But maybe someday we will fight each other. I have no reason to... trust you, or share information with you.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: So that's it then. But it doesn't matter. I've gleaned a lot from your attitude alone.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: By the way, have you been to the town?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What did you think of it?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It's a mess. The Infected have risen up in protest, and they're fighting with the non-infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Your people whipped them into a frenzy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: That's not good. So many innocent people hurt... But...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But until Wolumonde admits its guilt, and until they hand over the murderer, there can't be peace.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: How could I convince them to stop, when they're outraged by the deaths of their people...?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It sounds like things have spun out of your ability to control them.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes... More and more people keep getting sucked into it. Sooner or later, so will we...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We are not in a position to move around so easily, but you are.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Oh... I've said enough. I still can't completely trust you, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Right. Still not enough trust. So that's it... goodbye.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: GreyThroat! That guy's really scary! Even scarier than all those big Felines back at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: At least he wasn't being very aggressive. But if he does have a whole squad with him... Wolumonde is in no condition to fight them.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: So we let him go?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: A direct attack is out of the question, and agitating them will only make Wolumonde's situation worse. Not to mention, we still don't know where Atro is.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: If this does have something to do with Reunion, things will be much more difficult.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Have we made contact with Operators Folinic and Suzuran?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No. The town is so chaotic I was reluctant to even visit the town hall as an official representative of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But I found something very concerning. This doesn't seem to be a typical Infected conflict.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: True. Leithanien has always been rather gentle in its treatment of the Infected. Something very unusual must have happened to push things this far.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That 'Winterwisp' is an important clue. We might have to investigate it further. Ayerscarpe, you come with me. Click, I'd like you to scout out their camp.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We need to get a handle on the size of their team, and their modus operandi. Just a quick look. Carefully.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: *Sigh*. If I'd known it would turn out like this, I would have stayed in the dormitory to watch Leonhardt play with rocks...
Mmm——♪ Mmmhmm——♪
Winterwisp, oh, Winterwisp♪

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Winterwisp? Where did you hear that word?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Who are you? Rhodes Island? Outlanders shouldn't be meddling. This has nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: I don't know of any 'Winterwisp.' Leave me alone.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Winterwisp? No, there are no Winterwisps in Wolumonde. Haven't been for a long time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A long time?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: No, I mean... Oh, I shouldn't be talking to you.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Listen, I don't care what it is you're doing. But Wolumonde is a tighter community than you can imagine.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Most folks won't even tell you this rule, but I'll make an exception and explain it to you.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: The 'Winterwisps' are part of Wolumonde's history. But they're a pretty controversial topic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Seems to me there's a big controversy over the 'Winterwisps' right now.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: You mean the power plant getting destroyed the other day? There's worse than that...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Worse than leaving Wolumonde stranded in this wasteland in the dead of winter?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Wolumonde was hard-hit by the Catastrophe, and enduring the winter will be much more difficult.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Don't get ahead of yourself, outsider. This issue is absolutely taboo. The noble lords come down hard. And I don't want any trouble.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: If you really want to know about the Winterwisps, go ask them yourselves.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh... How can we find a Winterwisp if we don't know what it is? That doesn't make any sense...

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Figure it out yourselves. I don't know anything.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: He's gone. Can you believe that guy?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A tight community? It is really tight-knit.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Maybe we should go ask Mr. Severin...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Well, we did make a major breakthrough. I just hope he doesn't dodge the subject like he did last time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But the sun is already going down...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Blyat! How is it another day goes by and we're still none the wiser?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Please calm down, Miss Folinic...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm calm! I just... I...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There's something wrong here... I know it... But Atro... She... What the hell am I going to do...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What can I do? Mama...
Mmm——♪ Mmmhmm——♪
Such a brittle little branch~♪
Winterwisp, oh, Winterwisp♪
Weary of a long life, weary of a long death~♪
Sing out your song, firm and strong~♪
Singing through summer~♪
And on through winter~♪
Winterwisp, oh, Winterwisp♪
